'''Isabelle Ledoux-Rak''' (born 1957) is a French [[physicist]] and Professor at the [[École normale supérieure Paris-Saclay|École Normale Supérieure Paris-Saclay]], where she is director of the Quantum and Molecular Photonics Laboratory (LPQM - UMR CNRS 8537) and coordinator of the [[Erasmus Mundus]] Master's degree.<ref>{{Cite web|date=|title=ENS Cachan - Laboratoire de photonique quantique et moléculaire - Home|url=http://lpqm.ens-paris-saclay.fr/version-anglaise/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190818105006/http://lpqm.ens-paris-saclay.fr/version-anglaise/|archive-date=2019-08-18|access-date=2019-08-18|website=lpqm.ens-paris-saclay.fr|language=en|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=RAK|first=Isabelle LEDOUX|date=|title=Monabiphot|url=http://monabiphot.ens-paris-saclay.fr/|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2019-08-18|website=monabiphot.ens-paris-saclay.fr|language=en}}</ref> Her research interests focus on the study of the [[Nonlinear optics|non-linear optical properties]] of molecules and [[nanomaterials]].

== Education ==

Ledoux-Rak studied chemistry and physical sciences at the [[École normale supérieure de jeunes filles]], and joined the [[Ecole Nationale Superieure des Telecommunications]] to study [[engineering]] in 1981.<ref>{{Cite web|last=RAK|first=Isabelle LEDOUX|title=DGM - LEDOUX RAK Isabelle|url=http://dgm.ens-paris-saclay.fr/version-anglaise/top/directory/ledoux-rak-isabelle-24952.kjsp?RH=DL_LPQM-GB|access-date=2020-06-13|website=dgm.ens-paris-saclay.fr|language=en}}</ref> She obtained a Ph.D. in [[physics]] from the Centre National d'Études des Télécommunications (CNET) at [[Bagneux, Hauts-de-Seine|Bagneux]] in 1988, under the supervision of [[Joseph Zyss]].<ref>{{Cite thesis|title=Effets paramétriques du second ordre dans des composés organiques à forte non linéarité optique : solutions, cristaux massifs, couches minces|url=http://www.theses.fr/1988PA112164|publisher=Paris 11|date=1988-01-01|degree=thesis|first=Isabelle|last=Ledoux-Rak}}</ref> Her thesis studied the [[Nonlinear optics|non-linear optical properties]] of [[organic molecules]] and was distinguished with the Prize of the Physical Chemistry Division of the French Society of Chemistry.<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=December 2014|title=Ledoux-Rak Isabelle|url=https://www.femmesetsciences.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/actfs_isabelle_ledoux.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303182235/http://www.femmesetsciences.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/actfs_isabelle_ledoux.pdf|archive-date=2016-03-03|access-date=|website=Femmes et Sciences|language=fr|url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Research and career ==
Ledoux-Rak continued her postdoctoral research in non-linear optics at CNET until joining the [[École normale supérieure Paris-Saclay|École Normale Supérieure (ENS) Paris-Saclay (formerly Cachan)]] in 1998, where she was involved with founding the Quantum and Molecular Photonics Laboratory (LPQM) with her former supervisor, Joseph Zyss.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Holweck 2015 Prize Giving - Société Française de Physique|url=https://www.sfpnet.fr/holweck-2015-prize-giving|access-date=2019-08-18|website=www.sfpnet.fr}}</ref>

She has been a professor of physics at ENS Paris-Saclay since 2002, and director of the LPQM since 2006.

== Awards and honours ==
In 2015, Ledoux-Rak was awarded the [[Holweck Prize|Fernand Holweck Medal and Prize]] for her research on the non-linear optical properties of metal complexes and the detection of optical amplification phenomena at telecom wavelengths in polymer-based waveguides.<ref>[http://www.ens-cachan.fr/version-francaise/actualites/actualites-de-la-recherche/isabelle-ledoux-rak-medaillee-holweck-2015-316660.kjsp Isabelle Ledoux-Rak, médaillée Holweck 2015]</ref> She and Zyss also jointly received the Yves Rocard Prize of the French Physical Society for instrumentation in 1996.<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Prof. Isabelle Ledoux-Rak|url=http://esperia.iesl.forth.gr/~kafesaki/PHOREMOST-women/CV-Ledoux.html|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2020-06-13|website=esperia.iesl.forth.gr}}</ref>
